Figure 7 'Taxonomy of experiential memory paradigms. We classify approaches based on the abstraction level of stored knowledge: (1) Case-based Memory preserves raw trajectories and solutions as concrete exemplars; (2) Strategybased Memory abstracts experiences into high-level strategies, templates, or workflows; (3) Skill-based Memory distills procedural knowledge into executable functions and APIs; and (4) Hybrid Memory integrates multiple representations. Together, these systems mirror human procedural memory to enable continual learning and self-evolution. 'This figure draws inspiration from Сао el. al.
